newsitem.title: USA: USX-Marathon Group Q4 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: USX-Marathon Group Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Operating income figures for all periods are before extraordinary losses for the early extinguishment of debt.

In the 1996 Q4 and year, extraordinary losses were $7 million or $0.02 a share, on both a primary and fully diluted basis. In the 1995 Q4 they were $1 million or $0.01 a share. In the 1995 year they were $5 million or $0.02 a share.
Operating income is before preferred dividends. The company paid $4 million in preferred dividends in the 1995 year.

1996 Q4 includes favorable inventory market valuation (IMV) adjustment and a net gain on the sales of certain production assets, partially offset by an unfavorable domestic production tax adjustment for prior years.
1995 Q4 losses include unfavorable effect of adopting Statement of Financial Accounting Standards No 121, a favorable IMV adjustment, and a favorable adjustment related to federal income taxes.

1996 total year net income includes the favorable effects of IMV adjustments and gains on sales of various upstream and downstream assets, partially offset by an unfavorable domestic production tax adjustment for prior years and a charge for the withdrawal from the Marine Preservation Association.
1995 year net includes unfavorable effect of adopting SFAS No. 121 and a number of other special items.
